mapper.select: select c.id , c.nickname , c.comment , c.avatar_no as avatarNo , c.created_at as createdAt from comments c inner join posts p on p.id = c.post_id where p.slug = #{postSlug} and c.deleted_at is null order by c.created_at asc
select count(*) from comments c inner join posts p on p.id = c.post_id where p.slug = #{postSlug} and c.deleted_at is null
